units.source_text: 耳朵适应了，随之我听到了老师用极低的声音念念有词地诵读经文，却无法听出是什么经文。

en.t: As my ears grew accustomed to it, I heard the teacher muttering sutras in an extremely low voice, but I could not make out what sutras they were.

units.source_text: 老师身上有我们所不知晓的阴暗的精神生活，比起它来，我一向拼命地尝试的小小的恶、罪和怠慢就是微不足道的了。

en.t: Within the teacher there was a dark spiritual life unknown to us, and beside it the small evils, sins, and negligence I had always desperately tried to commit were insignificant.

units.source_text: 这种想法为了刺伤我的自尊心而突然出现了。

en.t: This thought suddenly appeared as if to wound my pride.
